message: 人間界の歩き方

name: Sally
message: 「Kyuuu~~, I lost……」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew. We managed to win……」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course we did, because justice is on our side.」

name: Sally
message: 「What justice! If you guys hadn't cheated, I would've won……」

name: Misa
message: 「I can't let that slide! We fight fair and square.」

name: Sally
message: 「You transformed even though you're human! Cheater, cheater, cheater!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am an angel, so it is not cheating.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that really the issue here……?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Awawa. I am not an angel. It was a metaphor meaning I am as cute as an angel. It was merely a metaphor, so please pay it no mind.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Everyone's nice, so you don't gotta explain it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please do not look at me with eyes of pity.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why do you not annihilate them」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Azel-san? Since when were you there?」

name: Misa
message: 「I didn't…… sense his presence……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't that 'cause you let your guard down?」

name: Synn
message: 「Annihilate…… You mean erase Sally-chan and the others?」

name: Synn
message: 「Going that far just for a dine-and-dash!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Right…… Even if they're demons, erasing them over something like this is……」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, it looks like they at least knew what they did was wrong this time」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We already beat them up pretty good, so how about we let them off the hook with this?」

name: Synn
message: 「Is this everything you took from 'Ponpoko'?」

name: Sally
message: 「That's all of it. He's sorry too, so forgive us this time, please!」

name: Ria
message: 「From now on, you can't dine and dash anymore, okay?」

name: Sally
message: 「What's 'dine and dash'?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. Starting from the basics.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Why play dumb now! You show no remorse whatsoever!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I think... she genuinely doesn't get it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's a huge culture gap.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They must not have guidebooks in the Demon World. How pitiful~」

name: Sally
message: 「Don't make fun of me! We've got a bestseller called 'How to Get Around the Human World'!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sounds like it'd get you lost.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, where's Azel?」

name: Ria
message: 「He's not here...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Seriously, what a mysterious transfer student.」

name: Sally
message: 「I won't do it again! So forgive me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, if you say so...」

name: Ria
message: 「Promise me. You must never do it again.」

name: Sally
message: 「I won't, I won't.」

name: Sally
message: 「So anyway, can you eat money?」

name: Ria
message: 「...Hmm. Coins are impossible, but you might be able to eat bills.」

name: Misa
message: 「Answering even a Demon in earnest--how kind you are, Big Sister...\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Looks like we still have a long way to go before she understands...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, this is the first time we've actually gotten through to her, so let's take it slow.」
